key.name: display-duration
key.summary: How long the strip stays up, in milliseconds
key.description: Time the strip stays fully visible after the slide finishes, before it fades out. Each new switch restarts it.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: How long the strip takes to slide to the new workspace while its name grows into the centre. 0 jumps straight there.

key.name: bottom-offset
key.summary: Distance from the bottom edge, in percent
key.description: Gap between the bottom of the monitor and the bottom of the strip, as a percentage of the monitor's height.

key.name: above-dock
key.description: When a Dash to Dock or Ubuntu Dock is on the bottom of the strip's monitor, place the strip above it; otherwise bottom-offset applies.

key.name: dock-gap
key.summary: Gap above the dock, in pixels
key.description: Pixels between the top of the dock and the bottom of the strip.

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Font size of the current workspace name, in pixels
key.description: Neighbouring names are drawn at neighbour-scale of this size.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Family name such as "Cantarell". Empty uses the theme font.

key.name: bold-names
key.description: Draw every name in bold.

key.name: neighbour-scale
key.description: Names one step or more from the current one are drawn at this fraction of the font size.

key.name: neighbour-opacity
key.description: Names one step or more from the current one are dimmed to this opacity; 1.0 means no dimming.

key.name: show-number
key.description: Prefix named workspaces with their number, as "2 · Name". Unnamed workspaces already show their number.

key.name: strip-width-em
key.summary: Strip width, in multiples of the font size
key.description: The pill is this many times the current font size wide (7.5 × 24 px = 180 px). Names beyond it fade out at the edges.

key.name: show-dots
key.description: A row of dots under the name shows which workspace is current out of how many.

key.name: unnamed-format
key.description: Shown for workspaces without a name. {number} is replaced with the workspace's number, counting from 1. Left blank, the number alone is shown.

key.name: use-custom-colors
key.description: Off, the strip uses the default colours. On, the colour keys below are applied.

key.name: pill-color
key.description: CSS colour string. Only its RGB is used; the opacity comes from pill-opacity.

key.name: pill-opacity
key.description: 0.0 is fully transparent, 1.0 fully opaque. Always applies, whether or not custom colours are on.

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the pill, in pixels
key.description: Radii larger than half the pill's height are clamped, so 100 gives fully round ends.

key.name: padding
key.description: Vertical space above and below the name. With the position dots on, 6 more pixels are added to make room for them.

key.name: name-color
key.description: CSS colour string.

key.name: neighbour-color
key.description: CSS colour string, may carry alpha. The name blends from this to the current-name colour as it slides into the centre.

key.name: dot-color
key.description: CSS colour string, may carry alpha.
